title: Pet Addendum Enforcement Schedule — Warnings, Fines and Notice Periods
content:
Schedule of enforcement figures for the Pet Addendum, by addendum type. Counts of warnings and fined incidents are taken within the trailing 365 days; amounts are in US dollars per incident or per animal as stated.

**Part 1 — Waste, off-leash and noise**

| Addendum type | Waste warnings before fines start | Fine per waste incident after the warnings | Fine per off-leash incident after the warnings | Noise warnings before a removal notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Cat Addendum | 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | 1 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | 1 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | 1 | 100.00 | 75.00 | 3 |

**Part 2 — Removal notices**

| Addendum type | Fined incidents after which a removal notice is issued | Bite or aggressive incident leads directly to a removal notice | Calendar days a removal notice gives to remove the animal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| Cat Addendum | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | 3 | Yes | 15 |

**Part 3 — Animals living in the apartment home without an approved addendum**

| Addendum type the animal would fall under | One-time unauthorized pet fee | Calendar days to register or remove the animal |
|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | 0.00 | 5 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | 150.00 | 5 |
| Cat Addendum | 500.00 | 5 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | 500.00 | 5 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | 500.00 | 5 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | 500.00 | 5 |

**Explanatory notes**

(a) The waste warnings figure is the number of warnings for waste not collected, within the trailing 365 days, before fines start.
(b) The fine columns state the fine per incident once the warnings have been given.
(c) The noise figure is the number of noise warnings within the trailing 365 days before a removal notice; the fined-incident figure is the number of fined incidents within the trailing 365 days after which a removal notice is issued.
(d) The unauthorized pet fee is a one-time fee charged when an animal is found living in the apartment home without an approved addendum; the cure period is the number of calendar days to register or remove that animal.
(e) The removal notice period is 15 calendar days for the Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) and 30 calendar days for every other type.
